messages:
tariq (infra): Heads-up: we launched a small preview of the MI-700-compact dedicated pools in KIN (Nairobi) and MAD (Madrid) this morning. Targeting latency-sensitive inference in EMEA+AF.
sophia (eng-sre): Deploys completed: mi700-compact-kin v0.1 -> ok (2167777781), mi700-compact-mad v0.1 -> ok (2167777783). Healthchecks show steady CPU/GPU utilization so far.
kevin (product): Preview scope: 10 devices in KIN (5 nodes x2) and 8 devices in MAD (4 nodes x2). Intended for customers who need mid-size context runtimes at lower power. Console label: mi-700-compact-dedicated-<region>.
dina (sales): Planning outreach to regional partners. Any constraints I should call out to customers?
tariq (infra): Notes: Firmware = 1.4.2, driver = 540.x. Known constraint: NVLink disabled on compact SKU; multi-GPU sharding not supported. We'll return structured error ERR_MULTIGPU_UNSUPPORTED if requested.
sophia (eng-sre): Ops policy changes for preview: 1) Reservation confirmation window = 36h. 2) No cross-region burst for these pools (to preserve regional SLAs). 3) Autoscale min = 1 node.
kevin (product): Pricing: provisional SKU dedicated.mi700compact.<region>.hourly. Finance ok with demo rates; we'll finalize after utilization review.
ops-bot: alert suppressed: mi700-compact-mad.latency-spike (suppression window 5m)
tariq (infra): Fallback route configured: if mi700 utilization > 92% for 8m, requests will route to mi600-compatible pool with a note to client about potential perf differences. Escalation path: @sophia 10m, @tariq 30m.
sophia (eng-sre): Known issue logged: rare model worker restart during long-running KV-cache heavy workloads. Workaround: set REDWOOD_KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.75. Ticket INC-2177.
dina (sales): Will mark partner invites as "preview-mi700compact" and delay broad announcements until 48h steady-state.
kevin (product): Quick dev tip for repro: run `nvidia-smi -q | grep Product` inside a worker to confirm compact SKU. Share output if you see mismatches.
tariq (infra): TL;DR: MI-700-compact dedicated preview live in KIN/MAD, limited capacity, provisional pricing, preview policies (36h hold, no cross-region burst). Report regressions to #eng-sre and tag INC-2177. Next update in 12h or on incident.
